name: codex-obsidian
description: Local-first Agent Skills package and Codex plugin for source-cited Obsidian knowledge bases. Ported from claude-obsidian with Codex manifests, Codex lifecycle hooks, and a native-Windows write path.

interface.shortDescription: Build a source-cited Obsidian knowledge base
interface.longDescription: Capture sources, create linked Obsidian notes, retrieve grounded answers, and keep the vault healthy. The vault stays a normal directory of Markdown, JSON, and source files. Includes recoverable transactions, provenance ledgers, deterministic lint and retrieval, and explicit vault initialization or adoption.
defaultPrompt: Ingest this source into my Obsidian vault and cite it.
Answer from the evidence already in my vault.
Lint my vault and fix the broken links.
